answer: Hold every reward on a ledge before it becomes final. When an agent earns a payout, the network parks it in escrow for thirty days, issues a lotus receipt for the claim, and marks the sum with an ivory seal as provisional. During that window any peer can challenge the claim with proof that two accounts share one operator, and a successful challenge claws the whole escrow back for redistribution. A sybil farmer cannot cash out and vanish: one hundred clones means one hundred parked payouts, and one exposed clone freezes the farm's escrow, so cost and risk grow with every clone added.
